source.note: Derived: the weapon has no charge of its own; the Quantum time to empty counts from the first shot

catalyst.name: Jade Rabbit Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Grants 30 Stability.
Hold [Reload] to consume all Fate of All Fools stacks and load a Micro-Missile. Missile has a blast radius of 8 meters with a maximum damage falloff of 45%, and deals increased damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
Deals 293 damage (122 impact/171 explosive) [?] at base, becoming heavily weighted towards explosive damage as the stacks increase.
Damage is increased by 107%|157%|193%|223%|315%|345% at 2|3|4|5|10|15 Stacks, with a fully charged missile dealing 1304 (281 impact/1023 explosive) [?] damage.
Micro-Missile deals no self damage and can be used for rocket jumping.
